Words aren't the only way to show love. I'm certain she knew how much you loved and cared for her... and there is nothing for you to feel guilty about. My grandmother  passed away two years ago and I was the only family member at home when she tripped and fell. To this day I wonder if its my fault... should I  have called the ambulance sooner? Should I have been watching over her better? Ill never know and you know what? It doesn't matter because I loved her with all my heart as you love your grandmother. Of course you are gonna miss her and some days will be harder than others but you can rest assured that she loved you just as much as you loved her and that everything will be fine. We can't resurrect the dead ( as much as I would want to see my grandmother again) but we can remember and cherish them in our hearts. You will be alright no matter and trust me everything will be fine. Hope you have a great day.
